## Fixed

- **Signing in works again.** Since 0.4.0, the sign-in check could fail with Cloudflare error 600010 and never go through. It passes now. Cloudflare may ask you to tap the box once, which is normal.

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.4.1.apk** below. It installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings.
